# Bohrium

> > Bohrium is an academic research platform providing access to scientific papers, scholar profiles, and educational content across computational complexity theory, cognitive psychology, network analysis, and other scientific domains.

The platform features SciencePedia educational articles on computational theory topics like NL-completeness and logspace reductions, alongside a comprehensive database of research papers with citations, abstracts, and BibTeX references. Bohrium also hosts detailed scholar profiles with h-index metrics and publication records from researchers at institutions worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Computational Complexity Theory
- NL-completeness & PATH problem
- Logspace reductions
- Graph reachability
- Space-bounded computation
- Nondeterministic logspace (NL)
- Immerman–Szelepcsényi theorem
- Professional creative thinking
- Cognitive psychology
- Network topology analysis
- Matrix entropy methods
- Scholar metrics & h-index
- Academic citation management
- BibTeX references
- Research paper database

## SciencePedia Educational Content

- [Path Is Nl-complete Under Logspace Reductions](https://www.bohrium.com/en/sciencepedia/feynman/computational_complexity_theory_undergraduate-PATH_is_NL-complete_under_logspace_reductions): PATH problem NL-completeness guide covering logspace reductions

## Research Papers & Citations

- [TYPES OF PROFESSIONAL CREATIVE THINKING: ADVANTAGES AND DISADVANTAGES](https://www.bohrium.com/en/paper-details/types-of-professional-creative-thinking-advantages-and-disadvantages/1080030663802880075-113602): R.V. Kozyakov paper on creative thinking with citations & abstract
- [Identification of Network Topology Changes Based on r-Power Adjacency Matrix Entropy](https://www.bohrium.com/en/paper-details/identification-of-network-topology-changes-based-on-r-power-adjacency-matrix-entropy/931753114334134379-603): Keqiang Dong paper on network topology using matrix entropy & citations
